workflow_guid.title: Workflow Guid
workflow_guid.description: GUID of the workflow the node is in.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Local name of the catalog the node follows - the directory it is installed under, and how the Catalogs settings page lists it.

catalog_name.title: Catalog Name
catalog_name.description: The catalog's own display name, as its manifest declares it. Falls back to the local name for a catalog no longer registered on this grid.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Who publishes the catalog, as its manifest declares it.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: Identifier of the catalog template the node was built from.

linked.title: Linked
linked.description: Whether the node still follows its catalog.

current_commit.title: Current Commit
current_commit.description: Catalog commit the node's files were last written from.

current_version.title: Current Version
current_version.description: Adapter version the node is on, e.g. '1.2.0'. Empty for an adapter that declares none.

available_version.title: Available Version
available_version.description: Newest adapter version this grid's copy of the catalog publishes.

available_commit.title: Available Commit
available_commit.description: Newest commit this grid's copy of the catalog has for this node's adapter.

update_available.title: Update Available
update_available.description: Whether the catalog publishes a newer version of this node's adapter than the one it holds.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why an update can't be applied, when the node is linked but its template is no longer resolvable.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Every node in the project that carries catalog provenance.
